scope: resiliency_tester.py lines 37-237 and 520-585 reviewed. Original diff/stat functions called unchanged on authored temporary binary files. Not whole module or whole-repository review.

result.cross_block_unequal_length_exception: AttributeError: BufferedReader has no attribute fstat

findings.detail: Diff loops over zip of nonempty blocks, discarding unmatched suffix bytes. If both reads then reach EOF, byte error is zero despite unequal lengths. Reproduced; file-count helper correctly reports inequality for that pair.

When one side reaches EOF before another nonempty block, code calls f1.fstat or f2.fstat, which BufferedReader does not provide. Reproduced with blocksize four, lengths nine and one. Remaining-byte formula also subtracts current block instead of including it; not separately executed beyond exception.
Directory comparators traverse only first directory and never enumerate extra second-directory paths. Extra output file is ignored by byte and file accounting; file-count behavior reproduced.

Main return checks only stats final error (byte percentage), not file-difference count. Same-block length counterexample yields byte error zero with file count one, so the chosen success predicate is insufficient. Full configured main not run.
execute_command discards imported module.main return value, unlike subprocess.check_call failure behavior. Configured Python commands may report failure numerically without stopping the harness.
compute_diff_stats divides by total compared byte count without zero guard; empty corpus or zero-byte corpus needs explicit policy. Static finding.
